Delivery Process

How It Works

A transparent four-step process built around clear communication, defined milestones, and dependable handovers.

01

Tell Us Your Idea

Explain your business challenge, desired feature set, or operational bottleneck through our structured project form or direct WhatsApp message.

02

Define the Scope

We review your requirements, prioritize features, and agree on a realistic proposal covering architecture, budget, and milestone delivery dates.

03

Build & Review

We engineer the agreed website, AI assistant, or automation system with iterative review checkpoints so you can test functionality early.

04

Launch & Handover

We deploy the deliverable to your production hosting, test end-to-end flows, and provide the agreed handover documentation and walkthrough.

Frequently Asked Questions

Clear Answers to Common Questions

Everything you need to know about partnering with Stack & Automation on your next digital or automation initiative.

What services do you offer? ▼
We engineer modern business websites and landing pages, AI chatbots and enquiry assistants, business process automations, Meta advertising workflows, bespoke internal software/dashboards, and reliable API integrations between your existing tools.
Can you build a custom solution? ▼
Yes. Every business has unique workflows and requirements. We design and develop custom solutions specifically around your existing tech stack, client journey, and operational goals. You can describe your specific requirements directly in the brief form.
Do you work with international clients? ▼
Yes, we collaborate with business owners, clinic directors, and founders across India and internationally. All project discussions, scoping, milestone reviews, and async updates are conducted seamlessly via WhatsApp, email, and scheduled video sessions.
How is project pricing decided? ▼
Pricing is determined by the specific scope of the project, functional complexity, integrations required, and agreed timelines. After understanding your requirements from your brief, we provide a transparent, milestone-based proposal with no hidden surprises.
How long does a project take? ▼
Timelines depend strictly on the project scope. Focused landing pages or business websites are typically delivered in 1–3 weeks, while custom AI agents or multi-system workflow automations range from 2–6 weeks. Specific milestone dates are established before work commences.
How do I start a project? ▼
Simply click "Start a Project" anywhere on this page, or select a service above. Fill out the brief form below with your requirements, review the formatted details, and launch the WhatsApp enquiry. We will review your brief and follow up promptly.
